page.overview:
Who is Jens 'Jeb' Bergensten?

Jens "Jeb" Bergensten is a Mojang Studios employee currently working as the lead creative designer of , and Minecraft Dungeons.

Jeb used the Minecraft Wiki as Jeb mojang, where he was particularly active in the issue lists, which he sanctioned as the official place to report and discuss Minecraft bugs and annoyances before the introduction of the official bug tracker.

In April 2013, he was included in the annual TIME 100 list along with Notch.

On May 11, 2013, Jeb married Jenny Bergensten (born Thornell), a photographer. They had a son (Björn Bergensten) on December 10, 2015.

Also known as: Jeb, Jens Bergensten.
